tools.name: resolve_listing
tools.description: Identify a Kingdom Hearts item from a marketplace listing (Mercari, Yahoo! Auctions, Suruga-ya, Mandarake, eBay…). Paste the listing title as-is (Japanese or English), e.g. {title: "一番くじ キングダムハーツ A賞 ソラ フィギュア 箱なし", price_jpy: 4500}. Returns candidates[] (sku_id, name_en, confidence 0-1, why, source_u

tools.name: resolve_listings_batch
tools.description: Run resolve_listing on up to 5 listings in one call, e.g. when comparing search results from a marketplace. Example: {listings: [{title: "…", price_jpy: 3000}, {title: "…"}]}. Returns an array in the same order; each element has the same shape as a resolve_listing result (or {error} for that one lis

tools.name: explain_product
tools.description: Get the full record for one Kingdom Hearts catalog item. Pass a sku_id from discover/resolve_listing (e.g. {sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a"}), or a free-text query such as {query: "Sora Bring Arts Halloween Town"} to get the best match. Returns names (en/ja), product line (maker, line type, release

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Browse the Kingdom Hearts merchandise catalog by character, budget and purpose. Use it to answer "what merch exists for X?" or "gift ideas under ¥5,000". Example: {ip: "kingdom-hearts", character: "Sora", budget_jpy: 5000, purpose: "display"}. Returns items[] (sku_id, name_en/name_ja, official, orig

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Estimate the total cost of buying an item in Japan and having it forwarded abroad. Example: {price_jpy: 4500, sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a", dest_country: "US"}. Returns routes[] (forwarding service × shipping method, with fees and total_jpy, cheapest first) and cheapest. Rough figures only: fee

tools.name: report_correction
tools.description: Report a mistake or missing item in the catalog (reviewed by hand before anything changes). Example: {sku_id: "ichiban-kuji-kh-2018-a", field: "msrp_jpy", proposed_value: "750", source_url: "https://…"}. Please include a primary source (maker, official shop or reliable press) when you can. Returns {
